Austria Travel.title: 5 Places to See in Zell am See, Austria (Lake, Glacier and Waterfalls)
Austria Travel.description: Zell am See puts a turquoise Alpine lake and a glacier in one trip. Ride up the Kitzsteinhorn to about 3,000 m for snow even in July, then see the Krimml Waterfalls, the highest in Austria. All 5, plus how to get there from Salzburg, in the guide.
